title: Prevent overlapping deployments
prompt: Add a concurrency group so only one deployment per environment can run at a time.
objective: Demonstrate the behavior of prevent overlapping deployments and capture verifiable evidence.

starter.code:
concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Replace with a controlled deployment step"
